name: ugc-voiceover-app-screen-showcase
description: A voice-only narrator TikTok/Reels ad pattern built around app screenshot walkthroughs. Opens with a sharp problem-framing hook overlaid on a key product screen, moves into a rapid multi-cut feature showcase with warm-authoritative voiceover, and closes on a brand-colored CTA card with a direct download prompt. Best triggered when the brand has a wellness, self-improvement, health-tech, or lifestyle-utility app with strong visual UI assets and a clear "you didn't know it was this easy" value pro
author: Official
